formSettings.name: Quan
formSettings.aboutme: Accomplished Senior Fullstack Engineer with over a decade of experience designing, architecting, and scaling high-traffic web platforms. Expert in building resilient, domain-driven backend systems using PHP/Symfony and crafting high-performance, responsive interfaces with React and Vue. Proven track record in leading technical strategy, optimizing cloud-native infrastructure for 99.9% reliability, and mentoring engineering teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure full-stack solutions.

work.title: Senior Software Engineer
work.summary:
Global digital services provider delivering scalable platforms and high-traffic applications for international clients across fintech, e-commerce, and media.

**Platform: Shovel — Multi-Channel Sync Middleware (Gambio, Afterbuy, Shopify)**
*Stack: PHP 8.4 (Symfony 7.4), Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, PostgreSQL (Doctrine DBAL), Redis 7 Streams (Symfony Messenger), Docker Compose.*
- Architected and led development of a multi-channel synchronization platform keeping products, stock, orders, and order statuses consistent across Gambio, Afterbuy, and Shopify for multiple enterprise customers.
- Designed a domain-driven, partner-agnostic backend (Integration / Sync / Job layers) using Strategy and Transformer design patterns, allowing each sales channel to be integrated and maintained independently with zero impact on existing partners.
- Delivered the Shopify channel integration — GraphQL API client, OAuth-based store authorization, and bidirectional product, order, stock, and category transformers — extending the platform to a third marketplace.
- Built a Redis Streams-backed job queue (Symfony Messenger) with per-customer distributed locking, enabling safe, high-throughput concurrent processing across multiple worker replicas.
- Implemented XML (Afterbuy), REST (Gambio v2/v3), and GraphQL (Shopify) API integration layers with structured, queryable sync logging for full operational observability.
- Developed the Vue 3 + TypeScript admin UI for multi-channel credential management, job scheduling, and log monitoring.

**Platform: German Recipe Portal (einfachbacken.de)**
*Stack: PHP (Symfony), React, Next.js, TypeScript, Elasticsearch, Redis, Varnish, AWS (EC2, S3, SQS), Superset, Node.js (NestJS), Python.*
- Architected and led end-to-end backend development for high-performance, scalable web applications.
- Built a scalable design system fostering visual consistency and accelerating delivery.
- Optimized Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS) via next/image (WebP/AVIF) and Intersection Observer lazy loading.
- Owned SEO infrastructure including JSON-LD structured data, dynamic Open Graph, and programmatic sitemaps.
- Built an Elasticsearch-based full-text search system with debounced suggestions and keyboard navigation.
- Built distributed systems leveraging queue-based architecture (AWS SQS) for asynchronous processing.
- Integrated AI infrastructure with MCP + Vector DB and developed streaming chat assistants.
- Improved API response time by 30% through advanced caching strategies (Redis, Varnish) and database optimization.

**Platform: GLS Bank — Internal Loan Management Web App**
*Stack: PHP (Symfony), Vue.js, Vuex, Vue Router, TypeScript, Vitest / Jest, Cypress / Playwright.*
- Architected the frontend from scratch, establishing coding standards and Vuex state management.
- Built complex multi-step loan flows with branching form logic and dynamic validation.
- Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) integrated with backend authentication services.
- Delivered loan dashboards and data-driven tables for financing lifecycle management.
- Established a robust testing culture with unit, integration, and E2E coverage.

**Key Responsibilities & Achievements:**
- Ensured 99.9% uptime across production systems through performance tuning, monitoring, and scalable infrastructure design on both AWS and Docker-based deployments.
- Owned end-to-end architecture for multiple concurrent platforms, from customer-facing e-commerce/fintech applications to backend sync middleware integrating third-party APIs.
- Designed resilient, domain-driven backend structures that let independent projects evolve without cross-cutting regressions, reducing onboarding time for new contributors.
- Led system improvements that significantly enhanced performance, maintainability, and SEO requirements.
- Mentored team members and led backend technical decisions, architecture reviews, and code reviews across projects.

work.title: Backend Developer
work.summary:

*Stack: Node.js, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Redis, Varnish, RabbitMQ, ElasticSearch.*
- Led a team of six in migrating the platform to Node.js and PostgreSQL.
- Optimized the system's performance, ensuring a seamless user experience during the transition.
- Implemented Redis, Varnish, and RabbitMQ for enhanced caching and messaging functionalities.
- Successfully migrated the core booking platform from ASP.NET and SQL Server to a scalable Node.js stack, improving system reliability and growth capacity.
- Successfully migrated the system to a new tech stack, improving performance and scalability.
- Enhanced user experience and system reliability, supporting the platform's growth.
